title: Classic Cactus
body:
Description

The Classic Cactus is the classic version of the Cactus and can be found around the desert area of the Classic Biome.

It was added in 1.29.0 when Oaklands hit 5 million visits. It was added back in version 1.57.0 when Oaklands hit 15 million visits. It returned again indefinitely upon the second anniversary party in a dedicated classic area off the shore of Ferwater Island.
